meta.title: Quiet Hollow
meta.tagline: Tend the garden. Heal the forest. Find peace.
meta.description: A cozy single-player puzzle-adventure where you play as a tiny forest spirit restoring a forgotten garden. Solve environmental puzzles by growing magical plants, redirecting water, and befriending woodland creatures. No combat, no time pressure — just gentle discovery and the satisfaction of bringing life back to a beautiful world.

skill_trees.name: Growth
skill_trees.description: Unlock new plant types and growth abilities.

skill_trees.name: Friendship
skill_trees.description: Deepen bonds with woodland creatures who help solve puzzles.

custom_mechanics.name: Plant Growth Puzzles
custom_mechanics.description: Plant magical seeds and use environmental interactions (sunlight, water, music, companion creatures) to grow them in specific patterns that unlock paths and restore areas.
rules: Each plant needs specific conditions: sun/shade, wet/dry, near/far other plants
Growth is real-time but accelerated — watch plants grow over 10-30 seconds
Some puzzles require growing multiple plants in sequence or simultaneously
Creatures can be directed to provide conditions (e.g., firefly for light, frog for water)
interactions: Plants interact with each other — some thrive together, others compete
Seasonal changes affect which plants can grow
Restored areas unlock new seed types

environments.name: The Hollow
environments.visual_description: A forgotten garden at the heart of an ancient forest. Moss-covered stone walls, crumbling fountains, overgrown paths. Soft watercolor palette of sage green, dusty rose, warm cream, and soft gold. Dappled sunlight through leaves creates shifting patterns on the ground.
environments.audio_mood: Gentle piano melodies, birdsong, rustling leaves, distant water trickling, soft wind chimes.

sub_areas.name: The Overgrown Gate
sub_areas.description: Entry area. Learn basic mechanics — clearing paths, planting first seeds, befriending a robin.

sub_areas.name: Sunken Fountain
sub_areas.description: Central hub with a broken fountain. Fixing it unlocks water mechanics for puzzles.

sub_areas.name: The Fern Grotto
sub_areas.description: Shaded cave area with bioluminescent plants. Light-based puzzles.

sub_areas.name: Treetop Canopy
sub_areas.description: Elevated garden area reached by growing climbing vines. Wind and gliding puzzles.

ambiance.lighting: Warm golden hour lighting. Soft bloom. Volumetric god rays through canopy.
ambiance.fog: Soft morning mist that clears as areas are restored.
ambiance.particles: Floating pollen, falling leaves, firefly lights, water droplets.
ambiance.sky: Soft watercolor sky visible through tree canopy. Warm sunrise/sunset colors.

player.visual_description: A tiny translucent spirit — about 6 inches tall — with a leaf-shaped body, glowing core, and trailing wisps of light. Moves with a gentle floating gait. Leaves small flower footsteps.

abilities.name: Plant Seed
abilities.description: Place a collected seed in fertile soil.

abilities.name: Sing
abilities.description: Hum a melody that affects nearby plants and attracts creatures.

abilities.name: Glow
abilities.description: Emit soft light to illuminate dark areas and guide fireflies.

npcs.name: Robin
npcs.description: A friendly robin who carries seeds to hard-to-reach places.

npcs.name: Old Fern
npcs.description: An ancient fern spirit who remembers the garden's history and gives gentle hints.

npcs.name: Puddle Frog
npcs.description: A cheerful frog who creates water sources and splashes to water plants.

categories.name: Seeds
categories.description: Plantable seeds for various magical plants.

categories.name: Decorations
categories.description: Cosmetic items to personalize restored areas.

textures.name: Watercolor Leaf
textures.description: Soft watercolor-style leaf texture with visible brush strokes and color bleeding.

textures.name: Mossy Stone
textures.description: Worn stone surface with soft green moss patches. Watercolor style.

animations.name: Seed Plant
animations.description: Spirit gently places seed, pats soil, tiny sparkle effect as seed burrows in.

animations.name: Plant Growth
animations.description: Seed sprouts, stem extends, leaves unfurl, flower blooms — all in graceful slow motion.

music.name: Hollow Morning
music.description: Soft solo piano with gentle string pads. Simple, memorable melody. 70 BPM.

sfx.name: Seed Plant
sfx.description: Soft plop followed by a gentle sparkle chime.

sfx.name: Flower Bloom
sfx.description: Musical chord that resolves — like a tiny bell choir.

ambient.name: Garden Peace
ambient.description: Birdsong, gentle breeze, distant water, occasional butterfly flutter.

voice.voice_description: Warm elderly female voice. Slow, kind, slightly raspy like rustling leaves.
sample_lines: The garden remembers kindness, little one.
Every seed holds a dream of sunlight.

vfx.name: Growth Sparkle
vfx.description: Gentle golden sparkles rising from growing plants like fireflies.

quests.name: First Bloom
quests.description: Plant your first seed and watch it grow. Learn the basics of the garden.

steps.description: Find a Moonpetal Seed near the Overgrown Gate.
Plant it in the sunny patch.
Water it by befriending the frog.
Watch it bloom and open the path forward.

quests.name: The Fountain's Memory
quests.description: Restore the central fountain by growing the right plants around it.

steps.description: Find 4 Water Crystal fragments hidden in different areas.
Plant Crystal Ferns around the fountain base.
Guide fireflies to illuminate the fountain at night.

rewards.unlock: Water mechanics and Fern Grotto access

ui.style: Hand-drawn watercolor borders. Soft, rounded UI elements. Paper-texture backgrounds. Everything feels gentle and inviting.

hud_elements.description: Small icon showing currently held seeds. Click to select.

hud_elements.name: Growth Energy
hud_elements.description: Tiny glowing orb that fills as you help the garden.

hud_elements.name: Creature Friend
hud_elements.description: Icon of current companion creature with friendship heart.

menus.name: Garden Journal
menus.description: Watercolor sketchbook showing discovered plants, creatures, and garden history.

menus.name: Seed Collection
menus.description: Pressed-flower style grid of collected seeds with growth condition notes.

menus.name: Map
menus.description: Hand-drawn map that fills in as you explore. Shows restored areas in color, unexplored in pencil sketch.
